kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Court ruling freezes Paramount-Warner Bros. merger for now
wire.summary: Paramount's owners were hoping they'd be firmly in control of rival Warner Bros. Discovery by the end of this week. Monday's temporary restraining order puts that plan on hold.

wire.title: India's Gen Z 'Cockroach People's Party' started as satire but is serious about change
wire.summary: They call themselves the "cockroaches" and they're on the march — demanding action against corruption, amid a shortage of opportunities for young people in India.

wire.title: Putin meets North Korean foreign minister in diplomatic push
wire.summary: The visit by North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui comes without an obvious occasion, such as a multilateral diplomatic event or state anniversary, and has raised speculation that she may be coordinating a possible visit to Russia by North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

wire.title: 3 U.S. personnel killed in Iran conflict. And, Hunter Biden opens up to NPR
wire.summary: Three U.S. service members have been killed since Friday amid rising tension between the U.S. and Iran. And, Hunter Biden talks to NPR's Newsmakers about addiction and public scrutiny.

wire.title: At least 930 people have died in Congo's Ebola outbreak
wire.summary: Congo's health ministry said the deaths were recorded out of the 2,344 cases confirmed as of Saturday. Thirty-seven new deaths were recorded in the previous 24 hours in one of the highest totals.

wire.title: U.S. and Iran launch new strikes after 3 U.S. service members are killed
wire.summary: The U.S. attacks were the ninth consecutive day of bombing since peace talks between the two countries collapsed in dispute over a memorandum of understanding focused on the Strait of Hormuz.

wire.title: Deloitte-run systems denied Medicaid to disabled people. New laws could make it worse
wire.summary: Complex computer systems that decide whether people get Medicaid benefits have a history of errors. Now, changes to comply with Trump's tax and domestic policy law are inundating those systems.

wire.title: So distressed you can't think straight? Lower the intensity with these 4 skills
wire.summary: A clinical psychologist shares effective strategies to quickly de-escalate stress and anxiety. That includes dunking your head into a bowl of ice water to trigger your mammalian dive reflex.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: The U.S. carries out a wave of strikes against Iran, as fighting between the two escalates, Congress faces long to-do list as August recess approaches, Andy Burnham becomes U.K.'s 7th prime minister.

wire.title: Andy Burnham becomes U.K. prime minister
wire.summary: In a transition of power presided over by King Charles, Andy Burnham has replaced Keir Starmer as the United Kingdom's prime minister. Both are from the center-left Labour Party.

wire.title: Trump says US strikes hit Iran in 'honour' of American soldiers killed
wire.summary: Iran responded with attacks in Syria and Jordan, as two ships reportedly exploded in the Strait of Hormuz.

wire.title: Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia
wire.summary: The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.

wire.title: Ten killed as Russian attacks on merchant ships in Black Sea intensify
wire.summary: Russian strikes on the Odesa region have killed 28 people in July alone, local authorities say.

wire.title: Rare identical quadruplets born in Australia
wire.summary: The parents of the four naturally-conceived girls were taken by "immense surprise" with the pregnancy, the hospital said.

wire.title: Notorious drug cartel leader Ismael Zambada sentenced to life in US prison
wire.summary: Known as "El Mayo", the co-founder the Sinaloa Cartel was also ordered to pay $15bn after he admitted to sending vast amounts of drugs to the US.

wire.title: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
wire.summary: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.
